relationships.subject: TLR4
relationships.evidence_quote: When peripheral nerve injury occurs, nociceptive transmitters combine with TLR4 and activate the receptor, NF-κB, downstream related factors and microglia.

relationships.subject: NF-κB
relationships.evidence_quote: This cascade promotes the synthesis and release of IL-6, IL-1β, TNF-α, iNOS and COX-2 to sensitized spinal dorsal horn neurons, which ultimately causes NP

relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: In the DRG and the spinal dorsal horn, TNF-α can activate NF- kappa B by binding to its receptor.

relationships.subject: minocycline
relationships.evidence_quote: As an inhibitor of microglia activation, minocycline (MI) reduces the expression and release of pain-causing substances such as IL-1, TNF-α and CX3CL1.

relationships.subject: CCL2
relationships.evidence_quote: Some studies have shown that intraspinal injection of CCL2 induced extensive microglia activation in the ipsilateral spinal dorsal horn.

key_findings: Review of microglia-mediated neuropathic pain: chemokines, cytokines (TNF-α, IL-1β), JAK/STAT3, PI3K/AKT, MAPK, TLR4/NF-κB and Notch pathways
Herbal compounds and minocycline reduce microglia activation and TNF-α/IL-1β release; TSPO imaging proposed for glia activation
